name: jfp-admin
description: AI-assisted Jesus Film Admin workflows for Experience locales and push campaign drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Create Experience locale drafts and push campaign drafts.
interface.longDescription: JFP Admin adds Codex skills for working with Jesus Film Admin through the JFP Admin MCP. Bulk Locale Factory creates, validates, reviews, and optionally publishes translated Experience locales. Push Campaign Drafts writes a draft push campaign in the languages you choose, and a person tests and publishes it in the dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Draft a push campaign in several languages
